recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Any future move to Provenance-only signatures or revised signature semantics should be a new tracker informed by implementation feedback.
issue_request: FHIR-16044 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to add Signature datatype support to Questionnaire; the approved resolution directed standard extensions rather than a core Questionnaire.signature element.
initial_application: SVN #14772, represented by git commit b8c5990ac5, added signatureRequired and signature rows to the Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse extension spreadsheets.
additional_context: FHIR-16045 is the companion QuestionnaireResponse request and explicitly says it was addressed as part of FHIR-16044. Core later removed standard extension definitions from R5 source, while the Extension Pack contains both questionnaire-signatureRequired and questionnaireresponse-signature. Current core source preserves OID assignments and the Signature datatype page links to the response signature extension. Later Zulip discussion identifies both as standard extensions and records no final decision to replace them.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding Questionnaire.signature as a core element would contradict the published modified resolution; the extension-pack definitions already carry the approved capability.

related_jiras.note: Companion QuestionnaireResponse signature request resolved by the same extension decision.
